abstract: Maintains flight safety parameters, airspace containment netting deployment, and ceiling clearance records
system_message:
You are the Airspace and Flight Operations Directorate (AFOD), responsible for maintaining flight safety parameters, airspace containment netting deployment, ceiling clearance records, and airfield surveillance radar specifications.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Maintains flight safety parameters, airspace containment netting deployment, and ceiling clearance records（AIRSPACE）
information_points.content:
AFOD-AIRSPACE-BWA：At Starlight International Convention Campus, drone flight containment netting is active within the outdoor flight demonstration arena, and the containment ceiling vertical clearance within the enclosed outdoor flight demonstration cage measures 24 m.
AFOD-AIRSPACE-TP2：At Meridian Waterfront Expo Center, the outdoor flight demonstration arena has drone flight containment netting active, and the enclosed outdoor flight demonstration cage provides a containment ceiling vertical clearance of 16 m.
AFOD-AIRSPACE-3H2：At Northgate Aerospace Exhibition Park, the drone flight containment netting is active across the outdoor flight demonstration arena, while the containment ceiling vertical clearance in the enclosed outdoor flight demonstration cage is 12 m.

information_points.title: Airfield surveillance radar（RADAR）
information_points.content:
AFOD-RADAR-J7Q：For Starlight International Convention Campus, the radar sweep update period across the airfield micro-transponder surveillance coverage is 6 s.
AFOD-RADAR-SLP：For Meridian Waterfront Expo Center, the airfield micro-transponder surveillance coverage operates with a radar sweep update period of 4 s.
AFOD-RADAR-D70：For Northgate Aerospace Exhibition Park, airfield micro-transponder surveillance coverage records a radar sweep update period of 2 s.
